data_description.voltage_on_threshold: Voltage above which the car is considered on.

custom_pid_edit.description:
**{action}: {pid_name}**

Enter a formula shorthand (e.g. `B(4)/2.55`, `B(4,5)/4`, `S(3)`, `BIT(2,0)`) or leave it empty and use the structured fields in the section below instead.

**Shorthand notation:**
• `B(n)` — unsigned byte at index n
• `B(n, m)` — big-endian unsigned word, bytes n..m
• `S(n)` / `S(n, m)` — signed equivalents
• `BIT(b, n)` — single bit n of byte b
• Optional `/const` or `*const` suffix

When you submit, you will return to the custom PIDs list. Changes are saved when you pick **< Back to menu**.

data_description.can_filter: Sets the ELM327 receive filter (ATCRA) to only accept responses from this ECU.
data_description.can_header: Sets the ELM327 send header (ATSH) to address a specific ECU.
data_description.init_extra: Extra AT commands sent before this PID's query (e.g. ATST32 for timeout).

data_description.device_class: Sets the sensor type (e.g. voltage, temperature, speed) for proper UI display and statistics.
data_description.expected_bytes: If non-zero, the ELM327 returns early after receiving this many bytes. 0 disables the optimization.
data_description.max_value: Maximum display value. Shown as an extra state attribute (not clamping).
data_description.min_value: Minimum display value. Shown as an extra state attribute (not clamping).
data_description.state_class: Sets how the sensor value is tracked over time (measurement for instantaneous, total_increasing for counters).
data_description.unit: e.g. V, A, %, km/h. Leave blank for unitless values.

data_description.bix: Bit position from the start of the response data bytes.
data_description.blsb: Reverses byte order before bit extraction. Use for Intel-format signals.
data_description.div: Divides the raw value after multiplication. Use 1 for no division.
data_description.map_text: Maps raw integer values to labels. One entry per line in 'value=label' format.
data_description.max: Clamps the result to this maximum after scaling.
data_description.min: Clamps the result to this minimum after scaling.
data_description.mul: Multiplied with the raw value before division.
data_description.sign: Interprets the extracted bits as two's complement signed.
